title: 36 Hours in Philadelphia
abstract: The city’s evolution from day trip to destination is such that you can spend a long weekend there without visiting any historic sites, and not even miss them.

title: 36 Hours in Toronto
abstract: This Canadian lakeside city offers a kaleidoscope of world cultures: sing karaoke in a Vietnamese bar, sip espresso in Little Italy and catch a new Bollywood release, all in one night.

title: 36 Hours in Prague
abstract: Go off the beaten track and explore the city’s courtyards and cobblestone lanes. With luck, you’ll find something that no one else has discovered.

title: 36 Hours at the Grand Canyon
abstract: Over four million people visit this remote corner of Arizona each year, and the experience can be a bit “death by gift shop,” if you don’t plan.
